name: Telur dadar
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: In a bowl, beat and mix the eggs.
Add salt, ground pepper, and chicken stock powder to the bowl. Mix.
Chop the spring onion, celery, and chillies.
Add the minced garlic, chopped spring onion, celery, and chillies into the bowl, mix again.
Scoop the corned beef and add it into the bowl. Press the corned beef with the spoon, mix again.
Optionally add slice tofu to the bowl. Do not mix, because it would crush the soft tofu.
Pour cooking oil to the pan, add the egg mixture and spread evenly.
Flip the egg when it's cooked at one side, and repeat this step when it's cooked at the other side.
After it's fully cooked, serve the telur dadar on a plate with soy sauce and fried shallots as desired.
